```{r}
#Import
eset_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "influenza_human_mouse_eset.rds"))
human_mouse_fluad_matrix <- eset_human_mouse %>% exprs()
human_mouse_fluad_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "influenza_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
```

##### RLE plot
Boxplot of expression or log2 fold change by participant or organism.

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Create a long format table
long_expr <- as.data.frame(human_mouse_fluad_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expression") %>%
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata, by = "sample_id")

# Calculate the median for each gene by organism
long_expr <- long_expr %>%
  group_by(gene, organism) %>%
  mutate(gene_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - gene_median) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot RLE
rle_plot <- ggplot(long_expr, aes(x = participant_id, y = RLE, fill = organism, color = organism)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, color = "red", fill = "red",
               data = long_expr %>% 
                 filter(participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                           "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                           "CRC305DGENT1471032"))) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint),  ncol = 1) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "RLE Plot by Organism", y = "Relative Log Expression", x = "Sample") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors$organism)+
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$organism) 

# Print
print(rle_plot)

#Save
rle_plot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_human_mouse_qc_rle_plot.png"),
         width = 18,
         height = 8)

beep()
```

#### Check distributions

##### From expression and log2fc
Save processed data to disk as an RDS file.

```{r}
#Raw expression + normalized
human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized <- GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  bind_rows(GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_symbol %>% 
              pivot_longer(-symbol,
                names_to = "sample_id",
                values_to = "value_raw"))

#Annotate ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn <- human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_qn") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized, 
               by = join_by("symbol", "sample_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata,
             by = "sample_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(value_qn, value_raw),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn.rds"))

#Calculate the avg expression
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarise(avg = mean(value),
            n_subjects = n(),
            sd = sd(value),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects)) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_avg.rds"))


# Log2FoldChange ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(measure %in% c("value_qn", "value_raw"),
         # timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)
         ) %>%
  select(participant_id, symbol, timepoint, value, measure, organism) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, symbol, measure) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_log2fc.rds"))

#Average L2FC
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarise(avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_subjects = n(),
            #Dispersion
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd,
            #Get pval from paired t-test
    pval <- tryCatch(t.test(value, day0, paired = TRUE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se,
         ci_high = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se,
         pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"))
  
#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_log2fc_avg.rds"))

beep()
```

```{r}
beep()
```

Sanity check

```{r}
# Calculate quantiles for each sample and measure
quantile_summary <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(sample_id, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(value, probs = 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("q"), names_to = "quantile", values_to = "value")

# Plot the quantiles
ggplot(quantile_summary, aes(x = quantile %>% fct_relevel("q0", "q25", "q50", "q75","q100"), 
                             y = value, 
                             group = measure, 
                             color = measure)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.2)) +
  labs(title = "Per-sample quantile distribution: raw vs. quantile-normalized",
       x = "Quantiles") +
  theme_vaxgo()

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(measure, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(value, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 
```


###### Averaged
Density plot comparing expression or log2 fold change distributions between organisms.

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}

#Plot average expression
distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot_data <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)) %>% 
  mutate(measure = case_when(measure == "value_raw" ~ "Not normalized",
                             measure == "value_qn" ~ "Quantile\nnormalized",
                             T ~ measure)) 


distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot <- distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot_data %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg) +
  
  #Human
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   fill = organism), 
               na.rm = TRUE,
               color = NA,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 0.2,
               data = distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot_data %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Human")) +
  
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = organism), 
               na.rm = TRUE,
               fill = NA,
               size = 1,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 1,
               data = distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot_data %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Human")) +
  
  #Mouse
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   fill = organism), 
               color = NA,
               na.rm = TRUE,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 0.2,
               data = distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot_data %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = organism), 
               fill = NA,
               na.rm = TRUE,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 1,
               size = 1,
               data = distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot_data %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  facet_grid(~measure~paste("Day", timepoint), scales = "fixed", axes = "all") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$organism)+
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$organism) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)) +
  labs(fill = "Organism",
       color = "",
       x = "Expression",
       y = "Frequency")

distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_plot

```





###### Boxplot by organism, averaged

###### By subject
Kaboxplot of per-subject expression with IQR boxes and quantile lines.

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=18}
distribution_check_subject_raw_qn <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)) %>% 
  mutate(measure = case_when(measure == "value_raw" ~ "Not normalized",
                             measure == "value_qn" ~ "Quantile\nnormalized",
                             T ~ measure)) %>% 
  droplevels()

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_kaboxplot_data <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(timepoint == 1) %>%
  mutate(measure = case_when(measure == "value_raw" ~ "Not normalized",
                             measure == "value_qn" ~ "Quantile\nnormalized",
                             T ~ measure)) %>% 
  group_by(measure, organism, participant_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(value, 0),
    q25 = quantile(value, 0.25),
    q50 = quantile(value, 0.5),
    q75 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    q100 = quantile(value, 1)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_kaboxplot_data_long <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_kaboxplot_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = q0:q100,
               names_to = "quantile",
               values_to = "value") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

distribution_check_subject_raw_qn_plot <- distribution_check_subject_raw_qn %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 1) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = value,
      x = participant_id,
      label = participant_id) +
  
  # Retângulo do IQR
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = organism), alpha = 1, width = 1) +
  
  #Connect quantiles
  geom_line(aes(group = quantile),
            color = "black",
            size = 1,
            data = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_kaboxplot_data_long) +
  
  facet_grid(vars(measure), vars(fct_rev(organism)), 
           scales = "free_x", 
           space = "free", drop = TRUE) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-5, 20)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$organism) +
  scale_color_manual(values =colors$organism) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "",
       color = "",
       x = "Participant",
       y = "Expression")


distribution_check_subject_raw_qn_plot
```

###### Plot correlation between genes (mean log2fc)
Scatter plot comparing human and mouse gene expression metrics.

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
#Plot correlation------
#Log2fc
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg_correlation_plot <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
    filter(timepoint %in% c(1, 3, 7),
         pval <= 0.05) %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, measure, avg_log2fc, organism) %>% 
  drop_na(avg_log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "avg_log2fc") %>% 
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(measure = case_when(measure == "value_raw" ~ "Not normalized",
                             measure == "value_qn" ~ "Quantile\nnormalized",
                             T ~ measure)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = Mouse,
      y = Human) +
  facet_grid(~measure~paste("Day", timepoint), axes = "all") +
  geom_point(color = "#90A4AEFF") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  labs(x = "Mouse Log2-Fold Change",
       y = "Human Log2-Fold Change",
       title= "Correlation plot, Log2-Fold Change")

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg_correlation_plot
```

Line plot of mean correlation over time with error bars.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human, matched timepoints ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- timepoints_human

#Matched timepoints
timepoint_combinations <- tibble(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                 timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse)

# Loop for matched timepoints
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test <- map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    comparison <- "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison <- "Human vs. Human",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison <- "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


#Unite
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary <- cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human,
    cor_mouse_mouse)

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

#Plot

  ggplot() +

      y = mean,
      group = comparison,
      color = comparison,
      fill = comparison) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low,

       x = "",

  theme(legend.position = "none") +
```

```{r}
#Boxplot by organism, averaged --------
```

##### Plot volcano plot
PCA plot of samples on the first two principal components.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=16}
#Volcano plot -------
volcano_data <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  mutate(logp = -log10(pval_adj),
         sig = case_when(avg_log2fc > 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Up",
                         avg_log2fc < 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Down",
                         TRUE ~ "NS"),
         measure = case_when(measure == "value_qn" ~ "QN",
                             measure == "value_raw" ~ "Raw",
                              T ~ measure))
volcano_plot_raw_qn <- volcano_data %>% 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_log2fc, y = logp, fill = sig) +
  facet_nested(~paste("Day", timepoint)+organism + measure, scales = "free_y",  space = "free_y", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig,
                 color = sig),
             pch = 21, 
             size = 1, 
             alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, color = "black", linetype = 2, size = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60),
                     limits = c(0, 70),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  labs(x = "Log2-Fold Change",
       y = "-log(FDR)",
       fill = "Direction") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)) 

volcano_plot_raw_qn

#Save
volcano_plot_raw_qn %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_human_mouse_qc_volcano_plot_raw_qn.png"),
         width = 16,
         height = 3)
beep()
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
# PCA with raw values
clean_matrix_raw <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(symbol %in% human_degs) %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_raw") %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "value") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

  filter(symbol %in% human_degs) %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_qn") %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "value") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()
```

###### By organism: Log2FC values
Run PCA on the expression or log2 fold change matrix.

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
# PCA -------

#Mouse only --------
annotation_samples_mouse_pca <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, organism, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()

# PCA with quantile normalized ----
clean_matrix_raw <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(measure == "value_raw") %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw_mouse <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_mouse_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw_mouse$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw_mouse$x)) %>%
  inner_join(annotation_samples_mouse_pca, by = "sample")



#Mouse with DEGs in human-------
annotation_samples_mouse_pca <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, organism, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get DEGs from human
pairwise_human_fit_measures <- readRDS(here("tables", "FIT", "influenza_human_mouse_fit_dge_pairwise2human.rds"))
human_degs_vector <- pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  filter(pval_adj_human <= 0.05) %>% 
  select(symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pull(symbol)

#Use only DEGs in human
clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(human_degs_vector),
         measure == "value_raw") %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(sample, symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Fill NAs with 0
clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs)] <- 0

#Normalize data
pca_raw_mouse_human_degs <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw_mouse_human_degs), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_mouse_human_degs_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw_mouse_human_degs$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw_mouse_human_degs$x)) %>%
  inner_join(annotation_samples_mouse_pca, by = "sample")
```

#=======================


#Hepatitis B
Import
```{r}
#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 
all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Hepatitis B")

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == "Hepatitis B")


#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)

#Input
filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"
```

#### SA Plot
SA or MA plot of expression vs. variability or log2 fold change.

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Create the SA or MA plot showing mean-variance relationship --------
# Add smoothed trend line and reference lines --------
sa_plot <- long_expr_log2fc_avg %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = sd_expression,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~organism+timepoint, scales = "free",
             nrow = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, color = "black", fill = "gray25") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Day 0" = "gray50",
                                "Day 1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "Day 3" = "#219ebc",
                                "Day 7" = "#669bbc")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "Avg log2-Expression",
       color = "Timepoint") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    )
```

##### Distribution, Expression, by subject, Kaboxplot
Kaboxplot of per-subject expression with IQR boxes and quantile lines.

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=18}

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint == "Day 1") %>%
  group_by(organism, participant_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(expression, 0),
    q25 = quantile(expression, 0.25),
    q50 = quantile(expression, 0.5),
    q75 = quantile(expression, 0.75),
    q100 = quantile(expression, 1)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long <- human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = q0:q100,
               names_to = "quantile",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

distribution_check_subject_plot <- long_expr %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "Day 1") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = expression,
      x = participant_id,
      label = participant_id) +
    facet_wrap(~fct_rev(organism), 
           scales = "free_x", 
           space = "free_x", 
           drop = TRUE) +
  
  # IQR
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = organism), alpha = 1, width = 1) +
  
  #Connect quantiles
  geom_line(aes(group = quantile),
            color = "black",
            size = 1,
            data = human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long) +

  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-5, 20)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "",
       color = "",
       x = "Participant",
       y = "Expression")
```

##### PCA: Expression and Log2fc
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == "Hepatitis B")

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"


#Import metadata
annotation_samples_pca <- long_expr %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, organism, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get DEGs in human
human_degs <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% #169.800 rows
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>%  #24.136 rows
  pull(human_symbol) %>% 
  unique()

beep()

# PCA -------

# PCA with raw values ====================
clean_matrix_raw <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")) %>% 
  # filter(human_symbol %in% human_degs) %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>%  
  select(sample, human_symbol, value = expression) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "value") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

#With outliers
pca_expression <- pca_raw_df %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = timepoint,
      fill = timepoint,
      shape = organism,
      label = participant_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8,
             data = pca_raw_df %>% filter(organism == "Human")) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             color = "black",
             data = pca_raw_df %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Day 0" = "black",
                                "Day 1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "Day 3" = "#219ebc",
                                "Day 7" = "#669bbc")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Day 0" = "black",
                               "Day 1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "Day 3" = "#219ebc",
                                "Day 7" = "#669bbc")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Human" =  21,
                                "Mouse" = 24)) +
  labs(title = "Log2-Expression",
       shape = "Organism",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = "none")

pca_expression 

# PCA with Log2FC ====================
clean_matrix_log2fc <- long_expr %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")) %>% 
  # filter(human_symbol %in% human_degs) %>% #Filter only DEGs in human
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(sample, human_symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_log2fc[!is.finite(clean_matrix_log2fc)] <- 0

pca_log2fc <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_log2fc), scale. = TRUE)
pca_log2fc_df <- as_tibble(pca_log2fc$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_log2fc$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

#Plots ------
#With outliers
pca_log2fc <- pca_log2fc_df %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = timepoint,
      fill = timepoint,
      shape = organism,
      label = participant_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8,
             data = . %>% filter(organism == "Human")) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             color = "black",
             data = . %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Day 0" = "black",
                                "Day 1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "Day 3" = "#219ebc",
                                "Day 7" = "#669bbc")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Day 0" = "black",
                               "Day 1" = "#caf0f8",
                                "Day 3" = "#219ebc",
                                "Day 7" = "#669bbc")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Human" =  21,
                                "Mouse" = 24)) +
  labs(title = "Log2FC",
       shape = "Organism",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = "none")


#Print
pca_log2fc

#Unite plots
pca_log2fc_expression <- (pca_expression | pca_log2fc) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
pca_log2fc_expression

#Save
pca_log2fc_expression %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_human_mouse_qc_pca_log2fc.png")),
         width = 7,
         height = 3)
```

#========================


#Influenza
Import
```{r}
#Input
filename = "influenza_fluad"
pathogen_selected <- "Influenza"
timepoint_selected <- "Day 1"

#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 
all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)


#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)


```

##### RLE plot
Boxplot of expression or log2 fold change by participant or organism.

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Plot RLE
rle_plot <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism) %>%
  mutate(expression_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - expression_median) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = participant_id, y = RLE, fill = organism, color = organism) +
  facet_wrap(~pathogen+organism+timepoint, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "RLE Plot by Organism", y = "Relative Log Expression", x = "Sample") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = sd_expression,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~organism+timepoint, scales = "free",
```

##### Distribution, Expression, by subject, Kaboxplot
Kaboxplot of per-subject expression with IQR boxes and quantile lines.

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=18}

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  group_by(organism, participant_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(expression, 0),
    q25 = quantile(expression, 0.25),
    q50 = quantile(expression, 0.5),
    q75 = quantile(expression, 0.75),
    q100 = quantile(expression, 1)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long <- human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = q0:q100,
               names_to = "quantile",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

distribution_check_subject_plot <- long_expr %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "Day 1") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = expression,
      x = participant_id,
      label = participant_id) +
    facet_wrap(~fct_rev(organism), 
           scales = "free_x", 
           space = "free_x", 
           drop = TRUE) +
  
  # IQR
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = organism), alpha = 1, width = 1) +
  
  #Connect quantiles
  geom_line(aes(group = quantile),
            color = "black",
            size = 1,
            data = human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long) +

  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-5, 20)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "",
       color = "",
       x = "Participant",
       y = "Expression")
```

#========================
#Staphylococcus aureus
Import
```{r}
#Input
filename = "saureus_infection"
pathogen_selected <- "Staphylococcus aureus"
timepoint_selected <- c("12h", "24h", "Day 1")

#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 
all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

all_degs_human_mouse$timepoint %>% unique()

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)


#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)


```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
rle_plot <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>%

  mutate(expression_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - expression_median) %>%

  ggplot() +
  aes(x = participant_id, y = RLE, fill = organism, color = organism) +
```

#### SA Plot

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Create the SA or MA plot showing mean-variance relationship --------
# Add smoothed trend line and reference lines --------
sa_plot <- long_expr_log2fc_avg %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = sd_expression,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~organism+timepoint, scales = "free",
             nrow = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, color = "black", fill = "gray25") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "Avg log2-Expression",
       y = "Standard deviation",
       color = "Timepoint") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, shape = 16)))
```

#Escherichia coli
Import
```{r}
#Input
filename = "ecoli_infection"
pathogen_selected <- "Escherichia coli"
timepoint_selected <- c("24h", "Day 1")

#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 
all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

all_degs_human_mouse$timepoint %>% unique()

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)


#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Create the SA or MA plot showing mean-variance relationship --------
# Add smoothed trend line and reference lines --------
sa_plot <- long_expr_log2fc_avg %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = sd_expression,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~organism+timepoint, scales = "free",
             nrow = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, color = "black", fill = "gray25") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +

  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "Avg log2-Expression",
       y = "Standard deviation",
       color = "Timepoint") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, shape = 16)))
```

##### Distribution, Expression, by subject, Kaboxplot
Kaboxplot of per-subject expression with IQR boxes and quantile lines.

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=18}

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, participant_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(expression, 0),
    q25 = quantile(expression, 0.25),
    q50 = quantile(expression, 0.5),
    q75 = quantile(expression, 0.75),
    q100 = quantile(expression, 1)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long <- human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = q0:q100,
               names_to = "quantile",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

distribution_check_subject_plot <- long_expr %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = expression,
      x = participant_id,
      label = participant_id) +
    facet_wrap(~fct_rev(organism), 
           scales = "free_x", 
           space = "free_x", 
           drop = TRUE) +
  
  # IQR
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = organism), alpha = 1, width = 1) +
  
  #Connect quantiles
  geom_line(aes(group = quantile),
            color = "black",
            size = 1,
            data = human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long) +

  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-5, 20)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "",
       color = "",
       x = "Participant",
       y = "Expression")


distribution_check_subject_plot
```

#==============
#Burn
Import
```{r}
#Input
filename = "burn"
pathogen_selected <- "Burn"
timepoint_selected <- c("2h", "Early hours")

#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 
all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

all_degs_human_mouse$timepoint %>% unique()

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)


```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Plot RLE

rle_df <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(expression)) %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, organism) %>%
  mutate(expression_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - expression_median)

rle_plot <- rle_df %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot() +
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Create the SA or MA plot showing mean-variance relationship --------
# Add smoothed trend line and reference lines --------
sa_plot <- long_expr_log2fc_avg %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = sd_expression,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~organism+timepoint, scales = "free",
             nrow = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, color = "black", fill = "gray25") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +

       y = "Standard deviation",
       color = "Timepoint") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),

          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, shape = 16)))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=10}
  facet_grid(~timepoint, scales = "fixed", axes = "all") +
  #Human
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   fill = organism), 
               na.rm = TRUE,
               color = NA,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 0.2,
               data = . %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Human")) +
  
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = organism), 
               na.rm = TRUE,
               fill = NA,
               size = 1,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 1,
               data = . %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Human")) +
  
  #Mouse
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   fill = organism), 
               color = NA,
               na.rm = TRUE,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 0.2,
               data = . %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = organism), 
               fill = NA,
               na.rm = TRUE,
               position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 1,
               size = 1,
               data = . %>% 
                 filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(FIT = "#4361ee",
                               Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               Human = "#90A4AEFF"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(FIT = "#4361ee",
                                Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                Human = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)) +
  labs(fill = "Organism",
       color = "",
       x = "Expression",
       y = "Frequency")
```

#============================

#Trauma
Import
```{r}
#Input
filename = "trauma"
pathogen_selected <- "Trauma"
timepoint_selected <- c("2h", "Early hours")

#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 
all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

all_degs_human_mouse$timepoint %>% unique()

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == pathogen_selected)

#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)


```

##### RLE plot
Boxplot of expression or log2 fold change by participant or organism.

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Plot RLE

rle_df <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(expression)) %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, organism) %>%
  mutate(expression_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - expression_median)

rle_plot <- rle_df %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = participant_id, y = RLE, fill = organism, color = organism) +
  facet_wrap(~pathogen+organism+timepoint, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "RLE Plot by Organism", y = "Relative Log Expression", x = "Sample") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.position = "top") +
```

#### SA Plot

SA or MA plot of expression vs. variability or log2 fold change.

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Create the SA or MA plot showing mean-variance relationship --------
# Add smoothed trend line and reference lines --------
sa_plot <- long_expr_log2fc_avg %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = sd_expression,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~organism+timepoint, scales = "free",
             nrow = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, color = "black", fill = "gray25") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "Avg log2-Expression",
       y = "Standard deviation",
       color = "Timepoint") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, shape = 16)))

sa_plot

sa_plot %>% 
ggsave(file = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_human_mouse_qc_saplot.png")), 
         height = 5,
         width = 10)
```

##### Distribution, Expression, by subject, Kaboxplot
Kaboxplot of per-subject expression with IQR boxes and quantile lines.

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=18}

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data <- long_expr %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, participant_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    q0 <- quantile(expression, 0),
    q25 = quantile(expression, 0.25),
    q50 = quantile(expression, 0.5),
    q75 = quantile(expression, 0.75),
    q100 = quantile(expression, 1)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long <- human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = q0:q100,
               names_to = "quantile",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  droplevels()

distribution_check_subject_plot <- long_expr %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoint_selected)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = expression,
      x = participant_id,
      label = participant_id) +
    facet_wrap(~fct_rev(organism), 
           scales = "free_x", 
           space = "free_x", 
           drop = TRUE) +
  
  # IQR
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = organism), alpha = 1, width = 1) +
  
  #Connect quantiles
  geom_line(aes(group = quantile),
            color = "black",
            size = 1,
            data = human_mouse_fluad_kaboxplot_data_long) +

  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), 
                     limits = c(-5, 20)
                     )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        ) +
  labs(fill = "",
       color = "",
       x = "Participant",
       y = "Expression")
```

##### PCA: Expression and Log2fc
Run PCA and format the PC coordinates.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}
long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated %>%  
  filter(pathogen == "Trauma")

filename = "trauma"

#Import metadata
annotation_samples_pca <- long_expr %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(participant_id, organism, timepoint, sample) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get DEGs in human
human_degs <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% #169.800 rows
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>%  #24.136 rows
  pull(human_symbol) %>% 
  unique()

beep()

# PCA -------

# PCA with raw values ====================
clean_matrix_raw <- long_expr %>%
  #Filter only DEGs
  # filter(human_symbol %in% human_degs) %>% 
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) %>%  
  select(sample, human_symbol, value = expression) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "value",
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
   drop_na() %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_raw[!is.finite(clean_matrix_raw)] <- 0

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_raw), scale. = TRUE)
pca_raw_df <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_raw$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

#With outliers
pca_expression <- pca_raw_df %>% 
  # inner_join(human_mouse_metadata %>% 
  #              select(participant_id, timepoint, age, sex), 
  #            by = join_by("participant_id", "timepoint")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = timepoint,
      fill = timepoint,
      shape = organism,
      label = participant_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  # scale_color_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Human" =  21,
                                "Mouse" = 24)) +
  labs(title = "Log2-Expression",
       shape = "Organism",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = "none")

pca_expression

# PCA with Log2FC ====================
clean_matrix_log2fc <- long_expr %>% 
  # filter(timepoint %in% timepoint_selected) %>% 
  # filter(human_symbol %in% human_degs) %>% #Filter only DEGs in human
  mutate(sample = paste0(participant_id, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(sample, human_symbol, log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample",
              values_from = "log2fc",
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("human_symbol") %>% 
   drop_na() %>% 
  as.matrix()

clean_matrix_log2fc[!is.finite(clean_matrix_log2fc)] <- 0

pca_log2fc <- prcomp(t(clean_matrix_log2fc), scale. = TRUE)
pca_log2fc_df <- as_tibble(pca_log2fc$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pca_log2fc$x)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_samples_pca, by = "sample")

#Plots ------
#With outliers
pca_log2fc <- pca_log2fc_df %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = timepoint,
      fill = timepoint,
      shape = organism,
      label = participant_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Human" =  21,
                                "Mouse" = 24)) +
  labs(title = "Log2FC",
       shape = "Organism",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = "none")

#Unite plots
pca_log2fc_expression <- (pca_expression | pca_log2fc) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
pca_log2fc_expression

#Save
pca_log2fc_expression %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_human_mouse_qc_pca_log2fc.png")),
         width = 7,
         height = 3)
```

#========================
# All


Load data and compute average expression and log2 fold change per group.

```{r}
#Import.
human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) 

all_degs_human_mouse <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))  %>% 
  #Get SD and SE
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata %>% 
               group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
               summarise(n = n()),
             by = join_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(se = abs(mean_l2fc / t),
         sd = se * sqrt(n))


filename = "all_human_mouse"

#Import
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))

# Annotate expression data
all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc %>%
  select(human_symbol, geo_sample, expression = value_raw, day0_value_raw, log2fc) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata, by = "geo_sample")

long_expr <- all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated 

#Average L2FC and expression
long_expr_log2fc_avg <- long_expr %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_subjects = n(),
            #Expression
            avg_expression <- mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_expression = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_expression = sd_expression/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Log2FC
            avg_log2fc <- mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_log2fc = sd(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_log2fc = sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size <- avg_log2fc/sd_log2fc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low_expression = avg_expression - 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_high_expression = avg_expression + 1.96*se_expression,
         ci_low_log2fc = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se_log2fc,
         ci_high_log2fc = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se_log2fc)


```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=16}
# Plot histogram of p-value or adjusted p-value distribution --------
all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  ggplot() +

          legend.position = "top",

          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, shape = 16)))
```

#### Before: SA Plot
SA or MA plot of expression vs. variability or log2 fold change.

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=16}
# Create the SA or MA plot showing mean-variance relationship --------
# Add smoothed trend line and reference lines --------
sa_plot_before <- long_expr_log2fc_avg %>%
  mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_expression,
      y = se_log2fc,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~pathogen+organism+timepoint, scales = "free") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)
    ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, shape = 16))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, color = "black", fill = "gray25") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$timepoint) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "Avg log2-Expression",
       y = "Standard deviation",
       color = "Timepoint") 

sa_plot_before

sa_plot_before %>% 
ggsave(file = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_human_mouse_qc_saplot_before.png")), 
         height = 12,
         width = 16)
```
